nodes.name: H0.23WO3/rGO synthesis
nodes.procedure: First, ammonium paratungstate hydrate (H40N10O41W12·5H2O) (100 mg) and graphene oxide powder (100 mg) were added to distilled water (100 mL) and magnetically stirred for 6 h at 70°C. After complete dissolution, the solution was freeze-dried to obtain a solid powder. This solid precursor was then calcined at 600°C under high-purity N2 protection. The as-obtained product was the interstitial hydrogen atom-modified WO3 supported on rGO, named as H0.23WO3/rGO.

nodes.name: WO3/rGO synthesis (two-step)
nodes.procedure: As a control experiment, a solution containing H40N10O41W12·5H2O and graphene oxide was hydrothermally treated for 6 h at 150°C to form hydrated tungsten oxide composited with rGO (WO3·0.33H2O/rGO) as precursor. Subsequently, the solid precursor was calcined at 600°C under high-purity N2 protection. The as-obtained product was tungsten oxide composited with rGO, denoted as WO3/rGO.

the cycled catalyst after 5000 cycles exhibits an almost fully overlapping polarization curve with that of the fresh catalyst, with only a negligible change (3 mV) in the overpotential at an ultrahigh current density of 100 mA cm-2.

nodes.characterization_summary: H_{0.23}WO_3/rGO shows tetragonal phase with peaks at 2θ = 22.9° (001), 24.1° (020), 33.4° (201); WO_3/rGO shows monoclinic phase with peaks at 2θ = 23.1° (002), 23.6° (020), 24.4° (200).
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 1d, the XRD pattern of the WO_3 / rGO sample shows a series of diffraction peaks corresponding to the monoclinic phase with the P2_1 / n space group (JCPDS No. 43-1035), and three strong diffraction peaks located at 2θ = 23.1°, 23.6°, and 24.4° ... the three strong diffraction peaks at 2θ = 22.9°, 24.1°, and 33.4° corresponding to the (001), (020), and (201) crystal planes of the H_{0.23}WO_3

nodes.evidence_snippet: A clear lattice of WO_3 particles was observed in the HRTEM image ... the magnified HRTEM image shows the lattice distances of 0.388 and 0.374 nm belonging to the (001) and (020) crystal facets of the tetragonal H_{0.23}WO_3

nodes.characterization_summary: WO_3/rGO shows W-O-W bending at 259.6, 326 cm^{-1} and stretching at 703.8, 801.8 cm^{-1}; H_{0.23}WO_3/rGO shows weakened peaks and new O-W-OH bending at 940.9 cm^{-1} confirming H insertion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectrum of WO_3 / rGO exhibited the two characteristic peaks for the bending model of the W-O-W bond at 259.6 and 326 cm^{-1} ... the peak at 940.9 cm^{-1}, corresponding to the bending vibration of the O-W-OH bond, was observed in H_{0.23}WO_3/ rGO

nodes.characterization_summary: H_{0.23}WO_3/rGO shows stronger O-H stretching at 3411 cm^{-1} and bending at 1383 cm^{-1} than WO_3/rGO, confirming -OH groups from H insertion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: H_{0.23}WO_3 / rGO shows an obvious increase in the absorption bands of the O-H stretching vibration at 3411 cm^{-1} and O-H bending vibration at 1383 cm^{-1} compared with WO_3 / rGO

nodes.evidence_snippet: The W 4f spectra of WO_3 / rGO and H_{0.23}WO_3 / rGO contain doublet peaks assigned to W 4f_{5 / 2} and W 4f_{7 / 2} ... these two peaks of H_{0.23}WO_3 / rGO (37.8 and 35.6 eV) have a remarkable shift to lower binding energy compared with those of WO_3 / rGO (38.2 and 36 eV)
